assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape 3:2 educational news scene for adult English learners, one frame, no collage. Create a polished realistic editorial illustration, clear objects, natural faces, navy and teal accents. Scene: a female news anchor with short dark hair and navy blazer sits at a modern television news desk. Behind her a large studio screen displays an aerial view of a fictional small town with a red pedestrian bridge over a river, a storm and flooded riverside street. Calm professional atmosphere, no injuries. This is scene 1 teaching HEADLINE: include a blank clean lower-third strip area for a HTML headline overlay added later, but NO lettering, captions, logos, numbers or watermarks anywhere. Wide clear composition, subject and storm image both legible. Only one image.
